title: Gig-to-Staff Transition Playbook — 45d Conversion Trajectory
content:
Purpose:
This playbook defines a repeatable 45-day pathway for evaluating, converting, and onboarding high-performing gig/contract contributors into full-time ICs at Redwood. It blends hiring decision gates, a lightweight interview rubric specific to conversion scenarios, and a practical skills-transfer and manager-handoff checklist so conversions land quickly with minimal disruption to project velocity.

Scope and audience:
- Audience: Hiring managers, people ops partners, staffing leads, and program managers running conversions from contractor/gig to full-time.
- Scope: US and EU hires for engineering, product, and platform teams. For regulated/Private deployments we add an extra security clearance gate (see linked artifact CONFLUENCE-4367).

High-level timeline (45 days):
Day 0–7: Conversion intake and intent
- Manager flags candidate and opens a Conversion Intake (JIRA-PEOPLE-1192). People Ops confirms headcount and initial comp band range.
- Quick calibration huddle: manager + hiring partner + eng lead (15–30m).
- Evidence packet assembled: 2–4 deliverables showing sustained impact (PRs, infra runbooks, perf metrics, customer feedback).

Day 8–20: Assessment and verification
- Behavioral + role fit interview (1–2 rounds, lightweight). See "Conversion Interview Rubric" below.
- Reference check protocol: internal feedback from triage stakeholders + two cross-functional peers.
- Compensation calibration: People Ops provides target and any counteroffer/retention uplift guidance.

Day 21–30: Offer and acceptance window
- Draft offer and manager sign-off. Use conversion template (linked in Confluence).
- Offer review with candidate; include role expectations, manager 90d priorities, and probation checkpoints.
- Candidate accepts or enters negotiation phase (target negotiation window: <= 7 days).

Day 31–45: Preboarding and first-30-day enablement
- Preboarding checklist executed (accesses, equipment, compliance training).
- First 30-day plan shared: 3 measurable goals and 3 stakeholders.
- Manager schedules weekly 1:1 for first 6 weeks and sets initial performance signals.

Decision gates and risk signals:
- Gate A (Day 7): Headcount and budget confirmed by People Ops. If not confirmed, pause conversion and document remediation plan.
- Gate B (Day 20): Assessment outcome — PASS / CONDITIONAL / FAIL. Conditional outcomes require a documented remediation plan and a 30–60 day probation with explicit deliverables.
- Gate C (Day 30): Offer accepted and start date confirmed. If declined, record reason and consider retention levers (counteroffer, adjusted role).

Risk signals to flag early:
- Repeated missed deadlines or low collaboration signals in the last 30 days.
- Escalations tied to security/compliance (immediate stop for regulated work).
- Mismatched expectations around time commitment or career aspirations.

Conversion Interview Rubric (single-page, 45–60m):
Purpose: Focus on evidence already observed while filling gaps through structured questions. Avoid full duplicative interviews — this is a conversion, not a vanilla hire.
Sections:
1) Context + impact (10–15m) — evidence review
- Ask candidate to walk through 2 highest-impact deliverables during gig period.
- Score: 0–3 on clarity of problem, approach, and measurable outcome.
2) Role-specific competency (15–20m) — targeted probes
- Probe 2–3 behaviors/skills aligned to the full-time job (e.g., system design for infra, product sense for PM, eval methodology for applied ML).
- Score: 0–3 on correctness, tradeoffs, and alignment with team needs.
3) Collaboration & ownership (10–15m) — cross-functional scenarios
- Use one hypothetical escalation they may face as full-time. Evaluate communication, stakeholder management, and escalation resolution.
- Score: 0–3 on ownership mindset, clarity, and follow-through plan.
4) Career aspirations & compensation fit (5–10m)
- Validate candidate's interest in the role, location, and career trajectory. Note any red flags (prefers gig/short-term only).

Scoring and decision rules:
- PASS: total >= 7 with no 0 scores in collaboration or security-critical areas.
- CONDITIONAL: total 4–6 or a 0 in a non-critical area; convert with a documented 60-day performance plan.
- FAIL: total <=3 or 0 in a security/compliance area.

Manager handoff & skills-transfer checklist (preboarding package):
- Tech artifacts: list of active PRs, ownership on infra components, runbooks, pipeline dashboards.
- Access matrix: current dev accounts, CI/CD tokens, cloud roles — audit and reconcile differences before full-time start.
- Knowledge capture: 30–60 minute recorded walkthrough of top 3 systems the candidate touches. Attach links to artifacts in the evidence packet.
- Stakeholder loop-up: sync with two cross-functional partners to confirm dependencies and transition timeline.
- Mentorship pairing: assign a buddy for first 90 days and document weekly touchpoints.

Preboarding tasks (Owner assignments):
- People Ops: draft and send offer, start background check (if required), confirm comp cert.
- Hiring Manager: prepare 30-day plan, schedule 1:1 cadence, gather code/runbook links.
- IT/Facilities: equipment order and onboarding assets shipped.
- Security: complete onboarding access review and necessary training.

Offer & comp guidance (practical notes):
- Use market band midpoint for conversions; consider retention uplift only when the risk of flight is high or the role is strategic.
- Transparent rationale: offer letter must include base, equity language, role level, and probation terms (if conditional conversion).

Templates included (linked or embedded):
- Conversion Intake sample (JIRA template) — quick fields to capture impact artifacts, requested band, and manager rationale.
- Short interview scorecard (single row rubric) — use for Gate B.
- 30/60/90 sample plan tailored to conversions.
- Offer email template with negotiation anchor and clear timelines.

Operational metrics to track (report weekly to People Ops):
- Conversion funnel: Intake -> Assessment -> Offer -> Acceptance -> Onboarded (45d).
- Time to decision (days) per stage; target median: <= 21 days to offer.
- Retention at 90 days post-conversion.
- Percentage of conditional conversions and their success rate at 90 days.

Manager checklist for first 45 days (quick):
- Week 0: ship equipment, confirm accesses, share 30-day goals.
- Week 1: daily check-ins (first 3 business days) then bi-weekly; clarify immediate priorities.
- Week 2–4: assign 2 tactical tasks that map to measurable outputs; sync with buddy weekly.
- Week 6: formal probation check-in if conditional; evaluate against documented deliverables.
- Week 8–10: calibration with People Ops on extension or full conversion.

Common friction points and mitigation playbook:
- Delay in comp sign-off: escalate to People Ops lead and provide temporary retention stipend if needed.
- Access mismatches: create temporary bridge accounts with strict expiry and audit.
- Confused role expectations: hold a 30-minute alignment session with manager + peer + candidate and publish a one-page role brief.

Appendix: sample conversion scorecard (one-line CSV friendly)
- Fields: candidate_name, manager, intake_date, assessed_by, score_context, score_competency, score_collab, total_score, decision, conditional_plan_link

Notes and open questions (work-in-progress):
- Should we standardize retention uplift bands by role family? (People Ops to propose).
- EU-specific probity checks may add 7–14 days; need a region-specific flow.
- Consider automating evidence collection from GitHub/Jira to reduce manager burden.

Owner and next steps:
- Owner: Maya Thompson (people-ops).
- Next review: 2025-07-01 with People Ops leadership and 2 pilot hiring managers.

Contact and feedback: send comments to #people-ops on Slack or add notes to CONFLUENCE-4367.
